env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

# Package patterns must identify one package before the compiler runs.
! logos context './missing...#Value'
stderr '^logos context: expected one package for "./missing...", found 0$'
! stderr 'panic:'

! logos context './...#Value'
stderr '^logos context: expected one package for "./...", found 2$'
! stdout 'type Value'
! stderr 'panic:'

# Literal paths and patterns with exactly one match both remain useful.
logos context './one#Value'
stdout '^type Value struct'
stdout 'One int'
! stdout 'Two string'

logos context './two/...#Value'
stdout '^type Value struct'
stdout 'Two string'
! stdout 'One int'

# The same selection rule applies to loGo/s modules.
cd ../l
! logos context './missing...#Value'
stderr '^logos context: expected one package for "./missing...", found 0$'
! stderr 'panic:'

! logos context './...#Value'
stderr '^logos context: expected one package for "./...", found 2$'
! stdout 'type Value'
! stderr 'panic:'

logos context './one#Value'
stdout '^type Value struct'
stdout 'One int'

logos context './two/...#Value'
stdout '^type Value struct'
stdout 'Two string'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.27
-- m/one/one.go --
package one

type Value struct { One int }
-- m/two/two.go --
package two

type Value struct { Two string }
-- l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27
-- l/one/one.lgo --
package one

type Value struct { One int }
-- l/two/two.lgo --
package two

type Value struct { Two string }
